Path 3, observabilityGOALS §4.2

OpenTelemetry and Jaeger

The default telemetry pipeline, and where cardinality cost is won or lost.

WHAT IT IS

OpenTelemetry: vendor-neutral APIs, SDKs and the Collector for traces, metrics and logs. Jaeger: the CNCF tracing backend, now built on the OTel Collector.

WHAT SETS IT APART

38 sessions mentioned OTel versus 17 for Prometheus directly. The scale lesson every time: two-stage aggregation and OTTL in the Collector cut series counts before they cost money.

WHERE WE STAND

Adopt the OTel conventions as they are. Watch the trap: switching to delta temporality breaks every rate() query.

"Two-Stage OTel Aggregation" (Yahoo); "Mastering OTTL", KubeCon NA 2026

ADOPT
